an5.176:1.1: Atha kho Anāthapiṇḍiko gahapati pañcamattehi upāsakasatehi parivuto yena Bhagavā ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. Ekamantaṃ nisinnaṃ kho Anāthapiṇḍikaṃ gahapatiṃ Bhagavā etad avoca:-- 2.
an5.176:2.2: Na kho gahapati tāvataken'eva tuṭṭhi karaṇīyā
an5.176:2.4: Tasmā ti ha gahapati evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ:-- 3.
an5.176:2.5: Kinti mayaṃ kālena kālaṃ pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja vihāreyyāmā ti. Evaṃ
an5.176:3.1: Evaṃ vutte āyasmā Sāriputto Bhagavantaṃ etad avoca:--
an5.176:3.3: yāva subhāsitañ c' idaṃ bhante Bhagavatā
an5.176:3.5: Na kho gahapati tāvataken'eva tuṭṭhi karaṇīyā
an5.176:3.7: Tasmā ti ha gahapati evaṃ sikkhitabbaṃ
an5.176:3.8: "kinti mayaṃ kālena kālaṃ pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja vihareyyāmā" ti. Evaṃ
an5.176:3.10: Yasmiṃ bhante samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, pañc'assa ṭhānāni tasmiṃ samaye na honti:
an5.176:3.11: yam pi 'ssa kāmūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:3.12: yam pi 'ssa kāmūpasaṃhitaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:3.13: yam pi 'ssa akusalūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:3.14: yam pi 'ssa akusalūpasaṃhitaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:3.15: yam pi 'ssa kusalūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti.
an5.176:3.16: Yasmiṃ bhante samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, imāni 'ssa pañca ṭhānāni tasmiṃ samaye na hontī ti.
an5.176:4.2: Yasmiṃ Sāriputta samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, pañc' assa ṭhānāni tasmiṃ samaye na honti:
an5.176:4.3: yam pi 'ssa kāmūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:4.4: yam pi 'ssa kāmūpasaṃhitaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:4.5: yam pi 'ssa akusalūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:4.6: yam pi 'ssa akusalūpasaṃhitaṃ sukhaṃ somanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti;
an5.176:4.7: yam pi 'ssa kusalūpasaṃhitaṃ dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ, tam pi 'ssa tasmiṃ samaye na hoti.
an5.176:4.8: Yasmiṃ Sāriputta samaye ariyasāvako pavivekaṃ pītiṃ upasampajja viharati, imāni 'ssa pañca ṭhānāni tasmiṃ samaye na hontī ti. 1.
